answer: Only count close calls toward a grader's standing. Seat odds come from how often an account matched the final verdict, but 5-0 panels don't count at all, since anyone can match those by voting the obvious way. Only 4-1 and 3-2 verdicts do. An account draws seats at half rate until it has 15 of those at 65% or better. Catching that a basalt quarry plan for a knoll fudged its ferrous dust numbers, when two other graders missed it, takes real reading, so a farm can't rubber-stamp its way into influence. Honest graders get there in a few weeks anyway.
